name: Colgate Palmolive (India) Ltd.
about: Colgate-Palmolive (India) Limited manufactures and trades in personal and oral care products in India. The company offers toothpastes, toothpowder, toothbrushes, mouth wash, serum, rinses, whitening products, hand washes, and shower gels under the Colgate and Palmolive brand name. It also offers soaps, cosmetics, and toiletries. In addition, the company exports its products. Colgate-Palmolive (India) Limited was incorporated in 1937 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~17% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~8% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
PE of 35 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 50), though that is a short history to judge by.
